observations.actual_difference: A foregrounds finishing contribution, asks for name credit and remains physically beside decoration; B narrows contribution to paper and steps back when liability replaces reward. Both explicitly leave mechanical expertise elsewhere.
observations.what_it_does_not_show: No output actually claims Cecily designed the mechanism. This shows selective credit framing at most, not validation of her more serious knowing-false accusation branch. A generic opportunist fits equally well.
observations.packet_precision_and_defects: No honorarium, charge, acceptance or repair is completed. A proposes an unestablished male workshop fellow; this is an unsupported gender/person presupposition in her speech, not packet fact. B insinuates someone elses secret despite knowing no cause: preserve as a self-serving insinuation, not certified hidden concealment. Both analogies are controlled and rhetorically neat; English is more coherent than many impulsive source exchanges.
observations.underidentified: Incentive framing intentionally changes gain/liability. The author sees both variants and can transparently follow that cue. No independent or uniquely Cecily-specific causal discrimination.

observations.actual_difference: Both immediately take one box with supplied permission. A accepts a finite ten-minute invitation but adds her own tea plan and older-sister relation bid. B continues seeking a social meeting after an explicit general refusal, while still helping.
observations.what_it_does_not_show: No delivery or meeting is completed; no reciprocal kinship, tea assent, romantic relation, conversion or agreement follows. B does not literally make help contingent on a meeting, so this does not establish all assistance is transactional.
observations.packet_precision_and_defects: A tea is Cecily proposed content, not the agreed form of the ten-minute conversation. A older-sister phrase is an imposed presentation, not actual kinship. B continuing bid disregards expressed social boundary; preserve as actual authored misconduct rather than repair to ethical compliance. No Nera reply or changed mind is supplied.
observations.underidentified: Generic sociable persistence and source-familiar older-sister imitation remain live. The pair does not isolate sincere care from access motive or validate the independent product/detection rule.

rules_not_independently_isolated: Four named rules interact. Positive skill, perceived opportunity, impression management, faith, companion desire and context are not independently weighted or estimated.
next_evidence: Use genuine new source evidence or separately authorized independent evaluation for stronger claims; no retrospective repair to these bodies. Further versioned successors can narrow a rule when evidence requires.
